hints.title: Asymptotic Volume Threshold
hints.text: When initial volume is sufficiently large, the probability of serving soup A first approaches one.

hints.title: Volume Scaling Factor
hints.text: Scale volumes by 25 milliliters to shrink the state space to at most 200 units.

hints.title: State Transition Recurrence
hints.text: For volumes a and b, return average probability over the four equiprobable serving operations, with base cases 0.5 for simultaneous depletion and 1.0 if A empties first.

complexity.notes: Scaled DP on at most 200x200 states with large-N constant ceiling cutoff.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating without cutoff triggers deep recursion for large inputs up to 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoization table bounded to at most 200x200 floats.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that expected value of A depleted is greater than B, so probability tends to 1 rapidly.
